s00210.summary: Tark calls a meta-sync while Marguerite points out the dying fern.
Tark asks motionless Thad for thoughts and the office wonders if he's alive.
Marguerite prods Thad with the hose; he topples, snoring, and everyone is sprayed.
Thad wakes asking if it is Friday, then lies back down.
Marguerite tells Tark the company has been out of money since March.
Tark surveys the failing office as the lights go out; Thad quips he said so.

s00832.summary: Felix and Renata prepare for twenty-three bus rollover patients with six beds.
The wall phone buzzes urgently; they argue over picking up and Renata answers.
Renata listens, jaw tightening, and silently hands Felix the receiver.

s00188.summary: Paz frets about asking Dewey out and Kira pushes her into it.
Kira asks if Dewey is going to the quarry party; Paz denies having a reason.
Max glides up and reveals himself as Paz's ex who she never called.
Bee and Arlo enjoy the drama, Dewey wipes harder, Kira offers fries.

s00711.summary: Soledad and Pavel check dropping flow in the hydroponics ring.
Soledad hears a faint rhythmic tapping like fingers on glass under the pump.
Commander Hanne enters and orders them to stop what they are doing.
Hanne reveals the culture in tube nine stopped being algae days ago.
The tapping grows louder at the far end and all three turn.

s00036.summary: A father sits frozen in the car outside the planetarium while his daughter watches.
Josephine asks if lateness is why her mother left and asks for a true thing.
Desmond admits he never knew how to do this; Josephine says being her dad is enough.
Josephine answers Maeve's call on speaker; Desmond admits he got lost and froze.
Desmond takes her hand and they cross the street to the planetarium.

s01243.summary: Four fishers wait patiently around the hole in a frozen lake hut.
A bite slips off and Kwame and Hartwell trade dry jokes about optimism.
Ranger Benedict steps in from the cold and accepts coffee from Astrid.
They wait quietly until Astrid's line twitches again.

s00850.summary: Wendell, Toby and Ray wait for a bite in the hut.
Bored Ray complains and needles Toby about slurping; Toby offers Pa cocoa.
Ray asks about Grandma, and Wendell says she came because he did.
The line twitches; the three huddle over the hole and wait together.

s01752.summary: Gwendolyn tries to run a fire drill while Tilly's headcount keeps changing.
An unlisted intern offers donuts and turns out to have been hired in an elevator.
Gwendolyn invokes protocol; Hal notes they have waited forty minutes for the all clear.
Smoke curls from a window, proving the fire is real; a window pops.
Tilly and Gwendolyn recount heads, adding Colton, while Hal wants donuts noted.

s00657.summary: Six bakers work through the night; one stands at an empty counter.
Hildegard points out Moses has no dough; the bakers stop and the back door rattles.

s01574.summary: Four soldiers crouch behind a dike in the mist with a dead radio.
Finch sees movement; Doyle asks about the ridge across open water.
A woman calls from the treeline; Tanaka translates and distrusts the repeated welcome.
A mortar hits the sluice and the soldiers scramble along the dike.

s01769.summary: Ernest waits confidently with his folder and ticket B-114.
He reassures himself with a recorded note, calm man, prepared man, while nerves build.
Ernest finds his proof of residence is missing and records the confession.
He walks toward the door, then returns and waits again with false confidence.

s01852.summary: Five people sit apart in the archive, Imogen reading a parish register.
Estranged Thaddeus crosses the room and sits opposite Imogen.
He asks if she found it; she found a name, not his, as the room watches.
Imogen turns the register around; Thaddeus recognizes his mother's handwriting.
Rosalie stands behind her mother, Imogen covers her hand, and Callum quietly leaves.

s01262.summary: Keepers crowd the penguin house as Wilfred holds the herring bucket upside down.
The herring spills; the keepers bicker over the penguin count.
Dr. Bhatt diagnoses the limping penguin as sulking over a rock.
Wilfred wades in to swap the penguins and the birds scatter onto his boot.

s02294.summary: Big Wendell and small Ada lock hands in a diner arm-wrestling match.
Wendell surges and pins Ada back to forty-five degrees before she rallies.
Ada drives back and slams Wendell's hand to the steel to the crowd's roar.

s01503.summary: A team rushes a ventilated patient up a hospital elevator.
The elevator stops in a power failure and the patient has no ten minutes.
Firefighter Captain Luciana pries the doors open and orders the patient out first.

s00493.summary: Inspector Lark questions Hortense about a man who died tasting honey.
A veiled man unmasks as Konstantin and names oleander nectar as the poison.
Paco's registry shows hive twelve was transferred to Hortense.
Hortense admits she fed Alistair his own greed to stop his exposure.
Isolde confirms oleander residue in the spoon and Lark closes her notebook.

s01575.summary: The family bakes chaotically, Gloria scolding Dennis's mounded sugar.
Maya tells the contest office the recipe is totally original.
Gloria presses Maya, who admits the recipe comes from the judge's own cookbook.
Dennis suggests adding cardamom, and Gloria asks Maya to fetch it.
Judge Prudence arrives early, recognizes page ninety-one, and approves the personal touch.
Toby asks if they win; Gloria laughs and says they bake.

s02346.summary: Skip Gretchen steadies the team and nervous rookie Ximena before the last end.
Bernie throws the first stone and Linnea and Ximena sweep on Gretchen's calls.
The stone stops dead center and the women silently look at it.

s01891.summary: Coach tells nervous Oz he needs a strike while teammates crowd him.
Oz bowls a quiet roll that leaves the ten-pin wobbling, then standing.
Oz clips the ten-pin on the spare and the team explodes in celebration.
The final score shows they lost by one; Coach calmly says pack up.

s00046.summary: Soldiers watch enemy tanks from the broken roof as Oyelowo curtly handles Louis.
The Tigers move; Oyelowo orders Gene to wire the others and they descend.

s00619.summary: Naomi and Callum watch an elderly couple and he reaches for her hand.
Callum admits he should have called and was a coward.
Naomi says her lighthouse letter was a goodbye, not an invitation.
Seeing the old couple, Naomi breaks and says she wants lasting love.
Callum offers his ring; Naomi gently pushes it back, saying keep it for now.

s00144_2.summary: Angelika opens the steel box and finds a tiny, priceless cheese.

s01880.summary: Detective Marchetti makes small talk with the laundry attendant in the quiet laundromat.
Marchetti notes Renata's hospital shirts and tosses the crossword clue alibi at Archie.
Tomasz enters and holds up a folded shirt; Renata drops her basket.
Marchetti names him unprompted and orders him to sit down.
Win the lawyer emerges from the closet and says the police only have one thing.
Marchetti stands and says they will start with the one thing.

s01267.summary: Darius pitches Penelope on rebranding their two-person team as the Alignment Pod.
Penelope notes eleven years without a new idea, then approves it for him alone.
Darius adds that the Pod will require a budget.

s00445.summary: Naomi and Devante rush up the stairwell with eight minutes before court.
A judge eating a sandwich on the landing probes whether her client will testify.
The missed wrapper causes a collision, scattering her folder; Reggie pockets a page.

s00735.summary: A family bickers inside a rocking minivan in a car wash tunnel.
Foam leaks in and the family argues over lasagne smells and neutral.
Pop-Pop asks if the brakes stick the brushes and everyone falls silent.
The brushes lift and the family erupts in helpless laughter.
